Bind v1 source closure, contracts, original checkpoint/canonical tensors, frozen I/Z/H, P0 KV lineage, original independently propagated reference extension and all historical evidence. execution_semantics: Only --execute runs native CPU software. Evaluate minimum then maximum even if H is identical, each from a separate copy of the frozen L20 parent. No baseline or neighbor execution. Require the unchanged full-vector L20 S18 gate before dispatch. Reuse the existing native RTZ driver and independent local/global evaluators: S0-S17 local, S18 original-input binary64-v1, exact residual and own empty P0 FP16 KV checks. Each candidate stops at its first failing stage and cannot enter the next layer. A numerical suffix failure leaves the other endpoint independently testable; authentication, state, dispatch, runtime errors or a failed L20 precondition abort the batch. Preserve partial reports and attempted invocation counts on error. Maximum six native layer invocations; only L21-L23. No state files are published.
historical_boundary: The original v1 wrapper remains BLOCKED/ACCEPTED_EXECUTOR_HAS_NO_NATIVE_EXECUTION_INTERFACE and its diagnostic remains ENDPOINT_EXECUTOR_PREFLIGHT_VALIDATED. The earlier preparation BLOCKED record and INCONCLUSIVE/L20_GLOBAL_GATE_BOUNDARY with 43 historical L21 invocations and 44 samples are unchanged. None of those are v2 invocations.
result_boundary: EXECUTOR_READY means interface, compilation, focused tests and frozen authentication only, with zero native invocations. BOUNDED_ENDPOINTS_PASS requires both endpoints to pass all three layers, but is not admission. ENDPOINT_GATE_FAIL reports a numerical boundary and exits nonzero; BLOCKED reports an explicit error and exits nonzero. No exhaustive search, minimality proof, scientific acceptance, policy adoption or successor publication follows from focused tests. Independent normal Host Reviewer reproduction is required; the Host, not this executor, owns review.
output: JSON on stdout and diagnostics on stderr only. Each delivery check is captured exclusively in a fresh versioned capture under build/q24_s16_l20_endpoint_l21_l23_execute_v2_attempt001. Never overwrite an existing capture. A later numerical execution must be separately selected and captured by Planner within its authorized versioned output scope.
